conclusion: Assumption-breaking matrix (7 cases + commitment reference): the closed-loop degeneracy V=L is EXACTLY preserved under speed asymmetry (vB 4.8 or 7.5 vs 6.0), action-set asymmetry (5 vs 3 turn levels), and finite-horizon terminal payoff; it is broken ONLY by interaction-strength asymmetry -- gun range (eta_r 1.25 vs 0.8: deviation 14.0) and firepower (eta_g 1.25: deviation 20.1).  The degeneracy is therefore an interaction-symmetry phenomenon, not a kinematic one: kinematic asymmetries leave it intact, asymmetries in the field strength itself destroy it.  This sharpens Proposition 1's scope and explains why the operating-speed effect (B4.2) lives in the committed/open-loop game rather than in the closed loop.
